name: valzargaming/discordphp-newsletter
description: A DiscordPHP bot that writes a daily activity newsletter from GitHub, Discord and Steam with a locally hosted Ollama model, sends it to its owner for approval (and LLM-applied edits), then posts it.

scripts-descriptions.unit: Run the unit tests (no network, no Discord, no Ollama needed).
scripts-descriptions.preview: Collect today's activity and print the LLM-written draft without touching Discord.
scripts-descriptions.phpacker: Build standalone binaries for both entry points (bot.php and preview.php) for every platform.
scripts-descriptions.phpacker:bot: Build a standalone binary for the bot (bot.php) into bin/build/bot.
scripts-descriptions.phpacker:preview: Build a standalone binary for the dry run (preview.php) into bin/build/preview.
scripts-descriptions.docs: Build the class reference into build/ with phpDocumentor (installed to tools/, see the README).
